item.title: Artists in DSP releases free Vowel EQ for Amorph + “Plugin Remix” Contest
item.dc:creator: Ronnie
item.description: Artists in DSP has announced the release of a free Vowel EQ patch for its Amorph audio plugin that turns ideas into instruments and effects using AI prompts. Vowel EQ boosts specific frequencies to create the impression of a vowel being articulated.
